applicable_when: The kernel performs a layout transpose: contiguous NCHW reads (x2 is the fast axis, stride-1 in load) but stride-3 stores (y0 + 3*x2 means consecutive threads write every 3rd float, wasting 2/3 of each cache line). Two complementary fixes: (1) Add tl.max_contiguous + tl.multiple_of hints on the load pointer so the compiler emits 128-bit (float4) vectorized loads from the contiguous input dimension. (2) Add @triton.autotune to explore larger XBLOCK values (256, 512, 1024) and more warps — the current 0.74 waves/SM means the GPU is only ~74% filled; larger tiles reduce launch overhead and improve L2 reuse. The store uncoalescing is inherent to the layout transform and cannot be eliminated without changing the output layout, but vectorized loads and better occupancy will hide the L1TEX latency.
